_about: Monsoon flooding and water-source ratings, compiled 2026-11-15 from public reporting. 'evidence' is 'sourced' when a named spot or report backs the rating, 'unverified' when no specific source was found and the rating is a best guess. Power cuts were dropped: no source compares outages by area.

waterlogging: Hebbal flyover ramps, Hebbal Circle and the Nagawara-Hebbal ORR stretch named in police waterlogging advisories
Sai Layout under 4-5 ft of water, HBR Layout and Nandagokula Layout flooded (May 2025)
waterSource: Residents report up to 60% of water from tankers; borewells dry in Sonnappa and Prakruthi Layouts

waterlogging: Kendriya Vihar flooded three times in Oct 2024; residents evacuated by boat
waterSource: Zone is in Cauvery Stage V, but villages like Kattigenahalli were still unsupplied in Jan 2025

waterlogging: Sony World signal on the vulnerable-spots list; ST Bed Layout and Ejipura junction flooded (May 2025)
Flooded in May 2025, pumps deployed at Anugraha Layout; built on the Parangipalya lake bed
80 Feet Road on the KSNDMC vulnerable list; no major flood event found
Whitefield Main Road and Mahadevapura among the worst hit in the Sept 2022 floods
waterSource: Among the worst hit in the 2024 water crisis; parts newly covered by Cauvery Stage V in 2025

waterlogging: Marathahalli flyover approach roads under water (Sept 2022), waterlogged again May 2025
waterSource: No locality-level source found; neighbouring Mahadevapura zone was tanker-dependent in 2024

waterlogging: Only one report of waterlogging at the Electronic City flyover
waterSource: Industrial township buys Cauvery water from BWSSB; surrounding layouts rely on tankers

waterlogging: Lake overflow flooded the ORR near Ecospace; boats used in Yemalur and Rainbow Drive (Sept 2022)
waterSource: No Cauvery connections as of 2019; parts covered by Stage V by 2025

waterlogging: Yeshwanthpur, CMTI, Goraguntepalya and Sandal Soap Factory junctions flood in heavy rain
waterSource: Yeshwanthpura zone listed under Cauvery Stage V; no locality-level confirmation
